item.title: AbbVie Aquipta EC Approval
item.description:
• Summary: AbbVie's oral CGRP receptor antagonist Aquipta (atogepant) has received European Commission approval for the preventive treatment of chronic and episodic migraine. This expands access to the drug in Europe, offering a once-daily oral option for migraine patients.
  • MoAs: Calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) receptor antagonist
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology
